name: influencer-multi-agent
description: 多智能体跨平台大 V 全自动运营交付系统：根据网上热点生成内容并跨平台发布

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ima/core && npm run build -w @ima/crawler && npm run build -w @ima/browser-mcp && npm run build -w @ima/publisher && npm run build -w @ima/cli
scripts.coverage: c8 --all --src packages/core/src --src packages/crawler/src --src packages/browser-mcp/src --src packages/publisher/src --src packages/cli/src --include 'packages/**/src/**/*.ts' --exclude 'packages/**/dist/**' --exclude 'packages/**/test/**' --exclude 'packages/browser-mcp/src/browser.ts' --exclude 'packages/browser-mcp/src/cli.ts' --exclude 'packages/browser-mcp/src/http-cli.ts' --exclude 'packages/browser-mcp/src/server.ts' --exclude 'packages/cli/src/*-smoke.ts' --exclude 'packages/cli/src/bootstrap-demo.ts' --exclude 'packages/cli/src/queue-daemon.ts' --exclude 'packages/cli/src/queue-worker-cli.ts' --exclude 'packages/core/src/dry-run.ts' --exclude 'packages/**/src/index.ts' --statements 95 --branches 75 --functions 85 --lines 95 npm test
scripts.release:local: npm run bootstrap && npm run queue:work && npm run cli feedback && npm run verify:readme
